definitions.explanation: A counter for small to medium-sized animals such as fish, insects, cats, dogs, etc. Not used for birds or rabbits.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}を{三|さん}{匹|びき}{飼|か}っています。
examples.notes: さんびき with voiced び

examples.japanese: {池|いけ}に{魚|さかな}が{何|なん}{匹|びき}いますか。
examples.english: How many fish are in the pond?

examples.japanese: {一|いっ}{匹|ぴき}の{犬|いぬ}が{走|はし}っています。
examples.notes: いっぴき with small っ and ぴ

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}で{蝶々|ちょうちょう}を{五|ご}{匹|ひき}{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I saw five butterflies in the garden.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{時|とき}、{家|いえ}で{犬|いぬ}を{二|に}{匹|ひき}と{猫|ねこ}を{一|いっ}{匹|ぴき}{飼|か}っていました。
examples.english: When I was a child, we had two dogs and one cat at home.

notes: {匹|ひき} is used for small to medium animals (fish, insects, cats, dogs, etc.) but NOT for birds ({羽|わ}) or large animals ({頭|とう}). Pronunciation varies: {一|いっ}{匹|ぴき}, {二|に}{匹|ひき}, {三|さん}{匹|びき}, {六|ろっ}{匹|ぴき}, {八|はっ}{匹|ぴき}, {十|じゅっ}{匹|ぴき}. The consonant changes between ひき, ぴき, and びき.
